title: Microsoft Cuts Its Own Engineers AI Token Budget
description:
Microsoft cut the AI budget for it's own engineers 😅 VP Jay Parikh told staff that "token-maxing" isn't the point. Default internal model is now the cheaper GPT 5 6, and from July each division gets a token target with per-employee spend tracking. Some engineers were burning a few thousand a month 🔥 Meanwhile revenue and profit beat Wall Street ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
